question: Facebook's average viewing time for videos left out every view shorter than 3 seconds. What did that do to the figure?
answer: Inflated it by 60 to 80%. Facebook told advertisers in 2016 that for two years its average-duration figure had counted only views of 3 seconds or more, dropping the many people who scrolled straight past. Leaving out the shortest views lifted the average. Advertisers had been sold a reach the numbers flattered.
move: Ask what was left out of an average before admiring it.
ask: Which average do I quote about my own work that quietly leaves out the bad days?
trap: Views under 3 seconds are tiny, so dropping them hardly matters.
reference: Suzanne Vranica and Jack Marshall, Facebook Overestimated Key Video Metric for Two Years, The Wall Street Journal, 22 September 2016
